investigations.title: Route locality and management-bypass audit
investigations.question: Verify that remotely controllable request data cannot classify a process-capable route as local, and that management-scope bypass prefixes cannot encompass spawn-capable paths.

investigations.title: Chat request and provider execution boundary audit
investigations.question: Trace attacker-controlled request, header, provider, and upstream-response values for unsafe URL construction, credential disclosure, unsafe transformation, or raw error propagation.

investigations.title: Prompt guard parsing and fail-closed behavior audit
investigations.question: Verify parsing, error handling, disabled-guardrail handling, and downstream body reuse do not create a bypass of security enforcement.
